definitions: Cobalt oxide obtained by roasting cobalt ore, used as a blue pigment.
A cobalt blue colour, like that of the pigment.

blocks.text: Zaffre, a prescientific, or alchemical substance, is a deep blue pigment obtained by roasting cobalt ore, and is made of either an impure form of cobalt oxide or impure cobalt arsenate. During the Victorian Era, zaffre was used to prepare smalt and to stain glass blue.
